article.headline: Smith scores 17, Central Connecticut St. knocks off VSU-Lyndon 98-55
article.description: — David Smith scored 17 points as Cent. Conn. St. beat VSU-Lyndon 98-55 on Tuesday.
article.linkText: Smith scores 17, Central Connecticut St. knocks off VSU-Lyndon 98-55

categories.description: Vermont State Lyndon Hornets @ Central Connecticut Blue Devils

event.description: Vermont State Lyndon Hornets @ Central Connecticut Blue Devils

keywords: Vermont State Lyndon Hornets @ Central Connecticut Blue Devils
article.story: NEW BRITAIN, Conn. -- — David Smith scored 17 points as Cent. Conn. St. beat VSU-Lyndon 98-55 on Tuesday. Smith went 6 of 11 from the field (3 for 6 from 3-point range) for the Blue Devils (4-2). Rashawn Tibby scored 14 points, shooting 6 for 10, including 2 for 4 from beyond the arc. Raphel Laurent went 6 of 8 from the field (2 for 4 from 3-point range) to finish with 14 points. Javen Reid led the way for the Hornets with 10 points. Xavier Rainwater added seven points for VSU-Lyndon. Jack Giarrusso finished with seven points. Up next Central Connecticut State visits Navy in its next matchup on November 28. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
